full_text: Superior Court of California, County of Los Angeles. Plaintiff's Claim and ORDER to Go to Small Claims Court. Case number: 26AVSC00192. Plaintiff: Nicolas Hernandez. Defendant: Local Initiative Health Authority for Los Angeles (L.A. Care Health Plan). Redacted legal packet detailing Knox-Keene network failures, unpaid Conlan claims, medical transportation denials, and formal administrative exhaustion prior to Small Claims filing.
